purpose: Explicit, reviewed grade evidence for the registered textbook source folders under archive/exams/textbooks/. Textbook paths carry no high/hN grade segment, so the catalog builder, the Archive 2.0 core matcher and the Worker saved-paper replay (archive/archive2-canonical.js pathGrade) all resolve a textbook source grade from this manifest. Keyed by the first folder below textbooks/.
curriculumPolicy: Folder/curriculum identity is recorded as found. A 2015 key is never converted into a 2022 key or vice versa (docs/rules/01_CANONICAL/JS아카이브_문항메타_파운데이션_운영규칙_v1.md:242).
gradeBasis: 2022 revised curriculum course placement: 공통수학1/공통수학2 are taken in 고1, 대수/미적분Ⅰ in 고2. 백발백중_공통수학2 and 비상교육_공통수학2 are 공통수학2 sets already registered with grade 고1.

비상_미적분1.reason: 27 files (8 JS and 19 images) byte-identical to 비상교육_미적분1. Not registered, so the catalog never carries the same questions twice; the 비상교육 folder is kept because it follows the naming of the other 비상교육 sets. This folder stays in the tree because docs/reports/archive-inline-image-inventory-20260915.json and its exact-count test (tests/archive-inline-image-inventory.test.js) reference both folder paths; deleting it requires regenerating that sealed inventory baseline.

unitKeysPolicy.profile: question standardUnitKey values are Archive unit-profile keys (H22-C-0N, H22-C2-0N ...); the unified unit layer classifies by key exactly as for every other source.
unitKeysPolicy.chapter: question standardUnitKey values are the textbook chapter numbering (H22-C1-0N, H22-C2-0N, H22-AL-0N, H22-MC1-0N). That numbering is NOT the unit-profile numbering (for example H22-C2-02 is 집합과 명제 here but 직선의 방정식 in the profile), so the key is never used as a profile key; the question standardUnit label is matched to a unit by exact name, otherwise the question stays in the subject 단원 미분류 scope.
